title: Machine Minds
summary: Unity tank shooter with machine-learning–driven adaptive difficulty and Firebase-backed leaderboards.
description: Machine Minds is a level-based 2D tank game built as a capstone project in Unity. The game tracks player metrics (accuracy, damage taken, survival, scoring) and combines that with survey feedback to adapt difficulty between levels using a Python logistic regression model. It supports desktop and WebGL play, and includes online leaderboards plus analytics integrations.

title: Poseidon
summary: Flash-flood prediction web app using React + FastAPI + machine learning for Florida cities.
description: Poseidon predicts flash flooding by combining historical flood datasets with weather features through a supervised machine-learning pipeline. The frontend focuses on an interactive map-based UX for location selection and prediction display, while the backend serves model inference through a Python API. The project was built as a disaster-preparedness focused app during a hackathon cycle.

title: UF-OneClick
summary: Subscription manager that centralizes tracking, payment timing, and spending insights in one platform.
description: UF-OneClick is a full-stack subscription manager that lets users add and track subscriptions, view monthly/annual costs, and monitor spending patterns through reports and visualizations. The frontend was built with Angular while the backend uses Go services and MySQL-backed persistence. The app was created as a UF-sponsored collaborative project with both frontend and backend contributors.

title: PRIMME
summary: Physics-regulated interpretable ML framework for microstructure grain-growth simulation.
description: PRIMME (Physics-Regulated Interpretable Machine Learning Microstructure Evolution) is a research-focused framework for training and validating neural-network models that emulate isotropic and anisotropic grain growth. It includes reproducible local and Colab workflows, visualization outputs for multiple simulation modes, and tooling for working with large scientific datasets.

title: Swipetunes
summary: Mobile music discovery app that uses Tinder-style swipe gestures to build playlists from Spotify recommendations.
description: Swipetunes is a mobile-first music discovery app where users swipe right to save tracks and left to dismiss them, creating playlists in a fast and familiar interaction model. The app supports Spotify login, recommendation-driven song queues, audio snippet previews, and a swipe history log. It was built as a milestone-driven project focused on clean UX, mobile gesture interactions, and playlist curation flows.
